U.A. Management Course.name: U.A. Management Course
U.A. Management Course.description:
💼 You learn the business side of heroics at U.A.: agency finance, contracts, public relations, media and crowds.

🏫 Class 1-I, 1-J or 1-K: case studies, group pitches, hero-ranking analysis and assigned roles at school events.
⚖️ No license: Quirk use is legal only in supervised training and in self-defense, and your work never needs a Quirk.
🤝 Agencies hunting for managers, reporters who want a quote from inside U.A., and Hero Course students who need help with their image.
🔓 Learnable later: Image Rebuild, Stadium Voice.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Media Presence +10, Business +10, Negotiation +5
⚡ Starting technique: Press Line
🎒 Starts with: U.A. school uniform, Tablet, Business cards, U.A. student ID, ¥10,000, School bag, Casual clothes, U.A. gym uniform
U.A. Management Course.traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: adult first-year, Management Course (Class 1-I, 1-J or 1-K): agencies, hero publicity, events. No license: Quirk use only in supervised training and self-defense; the work never needs a Quirk.
Access: campus, school media and event offices, agency offices on internships, press and organizer areas at assigned events.
Obligations: business, law, marketing and hero-industry lectures; case studies, projects, pitches; school-event roles; Heights Alliance dorms from day one, curfew.
Who notices: agencies seeking managers and publicists, reporters wanting an inside quote, Hero Course students wanting image help, teachers grading pitches.
Standing pressures: with All Might teaching, gate reporters want quotes from any student; the Sports Festival is the biggest broadcast and a talent market, then hero names and agency internships; any U.A. incident becomes an image problem the course studies live.
Typical week: news analysis, networking, part-time event work.
